Local Ordinance 99-9 Public Indecency

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE MAYOR AND COUNCIL OF THE TOWN OF PINE MOUNTAIN, GEORGIA, AND IT IS HEREBY ORDAINED BY AUTHORITY OF SAME, AS FOLLOWS:

A person commits the offense of Public Indecency when he or she performs any of the following acts in a public place.

- 1. An exposure of the sexual organs, to include the breast of a woman.

- 2. A lewd appearance in a state of partial or complete nudity.

- 3. A lewd caress or indecent fondling of the body or the body of another person. *This does not apply to a mother breast feeding in a discreet manner.

Rate Schedule:

Ist Offense $ 750.00 2nd Offense $1,000.00
